blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Although language is predominantly spoken, empirical tests of surprisal theory rely almost entirely on written text. In practice, surprisal is estimated using language models (LMs) trained on text and applied to transcriptions, creating a text bottleneck that limits evaluation of the theory in the spoken modality. We remove this bottleneck by estimating surprisal directly from the speech signal using a speech LM. This raises a key question: should surprisal be defined over realization-specific acoustic inputs or over abstract linguistic units? Since a single unit can have many distinct acoustic realizations, each assigned a different probability by the model, defining surprisal over abstract units is difficult. To address this, we introduce an importance sampling estimator that approximates the probability of an abstract unit by marginalizing over realizations generated by a text-to-speech model. Using pupillometry data from a listening study, we evaluate surprisal theory in this text-free setting at multiple levels of granularity. Obtaining surprisal from several speech LMs, we consistently find that surprisal estimated via importance sampling better predicts pupil dilation than realization-specific surprisal for words. We also find that surprisal values for sub-lexical units are predictive of pupil dilation. While we find that surprisal can be estimated without recourse to text, and that marginalizing over distinct realizations of words is more predictive of lexical processing effort, surprisal as a whole is not a strong predictor of change in pupil size, regardless of its source.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Human language is primarily a spoken phenomenon, yet empirical tests of surprisal theory rely on written text rather than the acoustic signal itself ( Hale, 2001 ; Levy, 2008 ; Shain et al., 2024 ) . 1 1 1 We note that signed languages constitute another major modality of human language production and perception ( Sandler and Lillo-Martin, 2006 ) . The challenges we discuss regarding the mismatch between text-based models and non-textual modalities apply equally to sign. In studies of reading, this assumption is natural: the input is discretized into written units, and text language models (LMs) can assign probabilities to those units directly. In studies of listening, however, the input is an acoustic signal.
Applying a text language model to a transcription of the acoustic signal introduces a text bottleneck: the probabilistic model is defined over written forms, while listeners receive and interpret speech.
This bottleneck is not only an inconvenience; it also obscures a fundamental question for calculating surprisal for a speech signal from a speech LM: what is the unit over which surprisal should be calculated?
blocks.zh:
人类语言主要是一种口语现象,然而对超声理论的经验性测试依赖于书面文字而不是声信号本身(Hale,2001年;Levy,2008年;Shain等人,2024年). 1 1 1 我们注意到,签字语言是人类语言生产和认知的另一种主要方式(Sandler和Lillo-Martin,2006年)。 我们所讨论的关于文本模式和非文本模式之间不匹配的挑战同样适用于签字。 在阅读研究中,这个假设是自然的:输入被磁盘化成书面单元,文本语言模型(LM)可以直接将这些概率分配给这些单元. 然而,在研究听觉时,输入是声信号.
将文本语言模型应用到音响信号的抄写上,引入了文本瓶颈:概率模型被定义在书面形式之上,而听者接收和解释语音.

blocks.en:
Existing work on spoken-language surprisal has generally followed the text-based approach by applying text LMs to transcriptions ( Shain et al., 2020 ; Wallbridge et al., 2022 ) . This assumes that textual representations are adequate proxies for the units used in listening.
Even when these transcriptions are in terms of units that are more representative of speech than graphemes (e.g., phonemes or syllables as in Pimentel et al. (2021) and Sohoglu et al. (2024) ), transcription omits prosodic, acoustic, and speaker-specific information present in the speech signal.
Speech LMs remove this bottleneck, but introduce a new problem: their probabilities are defined over speech-code sequences rather than words or phones.

即使这些抄录是用比石墨更能代表语音的单位(如Pimentel等人(2021年)和Sohoglu等人(2024年)中的电话或音节),抄录省略了语音信号中呈现的正音,声学,和演说者特有的信息.
Speech LMs去除这个瓶颈,但引入了一个新问题:它们的概率被定义在Speech-code序列上,而不是单词或手机上.

As these stimuli have minimal phonetic variation (one speaker, flat affect, read speech prosody), they provide a controlled auditory test case for asking which speech-LM surprisal quantity best predicts processing effort. blocks.en:
Surprisal theory is typically defined over abstract units such as words or phonemes ( Levy, 2008 ; Smith and Levy, 2013 ) , whereas speech LMs assign probabilities to acoustic representations. 2 2 2 We use the term abstract units to refer to any given unit that might compose one’s intended message when communicating, as opposed to the units that make up noisy observations of said message. See Vigly et al. (2025) for relevant discussion of noisy-channel inference models of language comprehension. This discrepancy between the abstract and the specific is known in speech as the lack of invariance problem: a single abstract linguistic unit can have infinitely many acoustic realizations, and
the same unit may be realized differently depending on its phonetic context ( Liberman et al., 1967 ) , speaker characteristics ( Peterson and Barney, 1952 ) , recording quality, background noise, and conditions of the physical environment (e.g., reverberation, echo, etc.), among other sources of variation.
As a result, the speech LM assigns different probabilities to different realizations of the same abstract unit.
Aggregating probabilities over the observed utterance therefore yields surprisal for that particular realization, not necessarily for the abstract unit. In the present work, we approximate abstract-unit surprisal by marginalizing over possible realizations with importance sampling ( Robert and Casella, 2004 ) .

blocks.en: Speech is continuous, but speech LMs operate over discrete frames. Surprisal can therefore be computed at the frame level, or aggregated over more conventional units such as phones or orthographic words. We calculate surprisal at each of these granularities to ask which levels of speech LM predictions can model listening effort.

blocks.en:
In our empirical analysis, we investigate the relationship between pupil dilation and speech-LM surprisal estimated at the word, phone, and frame levels using four
speech LMs. At the word level, we further compare realization-specific surprisal against our marginalized, abstract-unit estimate. We find that marginalized word surprisal better predicts pupil dilation than realization-specific word surprisal, though phone- and frame-level surprisal are also predictive.
Though surprisal is a weak predictor of pupil response as a whole, our results suggest that in spoken language comprehension, processing effort is better captured by probabilities over abstract lexical units than by probabilities over specific acoustic realizations alone.
Our main contribution, however, is methodological: we provide a framework for defining the relevant probabilistic event when obtaining surprisal from speech LMs. Applying this framework to diverse speech conditions stands to position generative speech LMs as tools for learning how factors such as speech content, speaker characteristics, and prosody interact to influence speech processing.

2.2 Speech Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 语言模式

blocks.en:
Whereas text contains natural boundaries between units (e.g., spaces and punctuation in many languages’ scripts), speech is carried by a continuous acoustic signal without natural boundaries.
Digitization of the speech signal yields a dense sequence of bit-valued amplitude measurements (e.g., 16,000 samples per second).
Although these measurements are discrete in a technical sense, treating them as independent units for language modeling is poorly aligned with linguistic structure, as strong dependencies between adjacent samples reflect low-level signal properties rather than meaningful linguistic variation.
In practice, speech LMs therefore operate over higher-level representations obtained by discretizing the signal using feature extractors or neural codecs ( Arora et al., 2025 ) .
An input acoustic signal is first passed through a feature extractor, yielding a shorter sequence of representations. These representations can then be quantized into discrete units from a finite set Δ {{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}{\color[rgb]{0.2656,0.4648,0.668}\Delta}}}} .

2.3 Converting Speech LMs to Text LMs

blocks.en:
Text can be straightforwardly modeled by defining Σ {{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}{\color[rgb]{0.7344,0.332,0.3984}\Sigma}}}} as an alphabet of units such as orthographic words. Prior work has studied the question of alphabet transfer in LMs, for example, to obtain a character interface from a token-level model ( Vieira et al., 2025 ; Snæbjarnarson et al., 2026 ) .
Similarly, we seek to model sequences of units such as orthographic words from a speech LM defined over a different alphabet, i.e., an alphabet of speech tokens.
This requires a function Ω : Δ ∗ → Σ ∗ {{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\Omega}}\colon{{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}{\color[rgb]{0.2656,0.4648,0.668}\Delta}^{*}}}}\rightarrow{{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}{\color[rgb]{0.7344,0.332,0.3984}\Sigma}^{*}}}} that decodes speech strings

blocks.en: 3 Estimating Unit Surprisal
blocks.zh: 3 估计单位

blocks.en:
We aim to investigate the relationship between next-unit surprisal under a speech LM and processing effort, as measured by changes in pupil size. Surprisal is computed for multiple units that vary along two dimensions: level of abstraction (abstract units versus surface realizations) and granularity of the acoustic signal (orthographic words, phones, and frames). This yields four surprisal estimates in total: abstracted word-level surprisal obtained via the estimator introduced in App. A , and word-, phone-, and frame-level surprisal computed directly over the acoustic signal (see Fig. 1 ).
Below we discuss the implementation of the estimator used to obtain surprisal over abstract units.

blocks.zh: 3.2 超额评估 理论

blocks.en: Using pupillometry data as the psychometric signal of processing effort, we assess the predictive power of surprisal values obtained from our estimates of the marginalized surprisal values for orthographic words from a speech LM. We also compare these against surprisal values derived from unmarginalized orthographic word, phone, and frame probabilities, i.e., the probability the speech LM assigns to units in the specific utterances in the stimuli.

blocks.en: 4 Analyses
blocks.zh: 4 分析

blocks.en:
In the empirical portion of the article, we carry out two analyses. The first serves to confirm that we are sampling utterances from a diverse range of speakers to justify our choice of proposal distribution.
Our second analysis assesses surprisal theory using surprisal from speech LMs to model pupil data.
blocks.zh:
在文章的经验部分,我们进行了两项分析。 第一点是确认,我们从各种发言者的发言中取材,说明我们选择分发提案的理由。
我们的第二次分析评估了从语音LMs到模拟瞳孔数据的超导理论.

blocks.en: 4.1 CSM Sample Diversity
blocks.zh: 4.1 中央管理系统 多样性样本

blocks.en: Though the authors anecdotally note variation between the voices and prosodic features of sampled utterances from CSM, we seek to quantitatively assess whether the N {{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}N}} realizations of our stimuli indeed capture a wide variety of realizations for the same phrase. To do so, we analyze speaker embeddings of our sampled utterances from a ResNet model pretrained for speaker verification using the SpeechBrain toolkit ( Villalba et al., 2020 ; Ravanelli et al., 2024 ) . By assessing whether we have sampled from a diverse space of speakers, we aim to justify our choice of proposal distribution.
blocks.zh: 虽然作者们以传闻的方式注意到了来自CSM的抽样言论中的声音和流派特征之间的差异,但我们试图从数量上评估N {{\color[rgb]{0,0}{0}}}N }}的实现是否确实为同一短语捕捉了各种各样的实现。 为此,我们分析了使用SpeechBrain工具包(Villalba等人,2020年;Ravanelli等人,2024年)预先培训的ResNet模型的演讲词样本。 通过评估我们是否从不同的发言者中抽取了样本,我们的目的是说明我们选择分发提案的理由。

blocks.en:
Specifically, we randomly select one of our stimuli and obtain speaker embeddings from each of the N {{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}N}} samples of that stimulus obtained from CSM. We then randomly select a speaker from the TIMIT corpus ( Garofolo et al., 1993 ) and obtain speaker embeddings from each of that selected speaker’s utterances in the corpus (“within-speaker” embeddings). Finally, we randomly select one of the sentences spoken by all 462 speakers in the TIMIT corpus train split and obtain the speaker embedding for each speaker using that utterance (“between-speaker” embeddings).
To assess speaker diversity, we measure the cosine distance between all speaker embeddings in each of the three sets of embeddings.

为了评估发言者的多样性,我们测量三套嵌入物中每套嵌入物中所有发言者之间的余弦距离。

Models are compared using ten-fold cross-validation by item (see App. D for descriptions of fold size), reporting differences in held-out log-likelihood relative to the baseline. Uncertainty is quantified via bootstrap resampling. To study whether our main effects models result in significant improvements over the baseline model in terms of predicting pupil sizes at a given time, we carry out one-sided paired permutation testing with B = 5000 B=5000 sign-flips and apply the Holm–Bonferroni procedure to correct for conducting multiple significance tests. We also use a one-sided, paired bootstrap test on the difference in held-out delta log-likelihood values to test whether marginalized surprisal values yield significantly higher delta log-likelihoods than unmarginalized surprisal values from the same speech LM.

blocks.en: Delta log-likelihoods for models of pupil size fit with various surprisal values at offset of ω = 1000 \omega=1000 ms are shown in Fig. 3 (see App. E for tables of values). Note that delta log-likelihood values can only be compared within each granularity, as each granularity represents a distinct regression problem defined over a different number of pupil observations: orthographic-word windows, phone windows, and frame windows ( Kiegeland et al., 2026 ) . At the word level, marginalized and unmarginalized GAMMs within a speech LM are fit on the same folds (and are therefore comparable), but delta log-likelihood is not comparable between speech LMs. Because of estimator error, the ratio in Eq. 8 can yield undefined surprisal values, meaning estimators for different speech LMs successfully yield estimates for different proportions of the tokens in the corpus (coverage for each speech LM is found in App. D ).
blocks.zh: 图3(数值表见App.E)列出了学生大小模型的三角洲对数,与各种附加值相匹配,乘以X=1000\omega=1000ms。 请注意,三角洲日志相似值只能在每个颗粒内进行比较,因为每个颗粒都代表着不同数量的瞳孔观测所定义的一个明显的回归问题:正字形窗口、电话窗口和帧窗口(Kiegeland等人,2026年)。 在单词层面,在语音LM中处于边缘和未边缘的GAMM是在同一折叠上相配的(因此是可比较的),但三角洲日志相似度在语音LMs之间并不可比. 由于估计错误,Eq. 8中的比例可以产生未定义的附加值,意思是不同语音LMs的预测器成功得出了本体中不同比例的符号的估计数(每个语音LM的涵盖范围见App. D.).

At the word level, we observe that fitting GAMMs with marginalized surprisals consistently results in higher delta log-likelihoods than fitting GAMMs with unmarginalized lexical surprisals from the same speech LM, regardless of the offset. Improvements in delta log-likelihoods from phone and frame surprisals are generally highest at 900 and 1000 ms offsets.

blocks.en: For reference, we also fit models of pupil size using word-level surprisals obtained from the text LM GPT-2 ( Radford et al., 2019 ) over the stimuli transcriptions (see § E.1 for details and results). These also result in significant improvements over the baseline with no surprisal. The larger the offset used, the less predictive GPT-2-derived surprisals are of pupil size. We note that comparison with word-level delta log-likelihoods from speech LMs is not warranted. Regardless of the specific delta log-likelihoods obtained, our approach derives the target predictor (surprisal) from the same input signal as participants in the pupillometry study, making it a more valid approach to obtaining surprisal in a listening comprehension study than using the transcribed speech as the input signal.
blocks.zh: 为了参考,我们还采用从文字LM GPT-2(拉德福德等人,2019年)中获取的词级附加物,将学生大小模型与刺激语录相匹配(详情和结果见E.1节)。 这还导致比基线大有改进,没有追加。 使用的抵消量越大,预测的GPT-2产生的附加物就越少。 我们注意到,没有必要与语言语言语言的字级三角洲日志比较。 无论获得何种特定的三角洲日志相似性,我们的方法都从与学生测量研究参与者相同的输入信号(surprisal)中得出目标预测器(surprisal),使它成为在听力理解研究中获得超参数的有效方法,而不是将转录的语音作为输入信号.

blocks.en: Finally, we refit our models, now adding a smooth term for the item-normalized time at which pupil dilation is recorded. Adding this term to both the main effects models and the baseline allows us to consider the extent to which surprisal adds predictive power to pupil dilation beyond the time in the sequence. The results indicate that adding surprisal to the baseline of time and random effects for participants and items does not result in significant improvements, regardless of the modality or granularity of the unit.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们重新修复我们的模型,现在增加了一个平滑的术语,用于记录瞳孔扩张的正常时间。 在主要效果模型和基线中添加这一术语,使我们能够考虑在序列中超过时间的瞳孔放大中,外加预测力的程度。 结果表明,在时间基线中增加附加,对参与者和项目随机影响,无论单位模式或颗粒性如何,都不会带来重大改善.

blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
In the present work, we asked how surprisal should be defined when it is estimated from the acoustic signal using a speech LM rather than from text.
Because speech LMs assign probabilities to speech-code sequences, their probabilities can be interpreted either as probabilities of specific acoustic realizations or, after marginalizing over possible realizations, as probabilities of abstract linguistic units.
Our results favor the latter interpretation at the word level: marginalized surprisal estimates for abstract lexical units were more predictive of pupil dilation than realization-specific word surprisal. At the same time, surprisal computed over finer-grained units (phones and frames) also improved models of pupil size, suggesting that speech-LM probabilities can model information relevant to listening effort at multiple granularities.
blocks.zh:
在目前的工作中,我们问到,当用语音LM而不是文字从声信号中估算出来时,应如何界定附加物。
因为语音LMS为语音编码序列分配概率,它们的概率可以被解释为特定声学实现的概率,或者在边缘化于可能实现后,被解释为抽象语言单元的概率.
我们的结果赞成后一种解释在单词层面:抽象语法单元的边缘化的超导估计比实现特定的单词超导更能预测瞳孔扩张. 同时,在精细的分层单元(电话和帧)之上的超额计算也改进了学生规模模型,表明语音-LM概率可以模拟与多个颗粒体的监听工作有关的信息。

blocks.en:
Taken together, our results suggest that in speech processing, humans are able to abstract over varying acoustic characteristics of input and use abstract lexical units to make inferences about upcoming words. This being the case, models of speech comprehension should distinguish between the probability of a particular acoustic realization and the probability of the abstract lexical unit it realizes.
This is consistent with the speech perception literature: ERP data collected while participants listened to stories indicate that listeners anticipate next words given a context ( Van Berkum et al., 2005 ) , and word recognition in noisy conditions is easier when the word is semantically or grammatically predictable in context ( Miller and Isard, 1963 ) . Moreover, there is evidence from pupillometry studies that with more context, repairing misheard words requires less cognitive effort ( Smith and Winn, 2025 ) . Our findings also parallel work on reading comprehension, for example the finding by Vigly et al. (2025) that surprisal of surface forms is no longer predictive of reading times in texts with typographical errors.
blocks.zh:
综上所述,我们的结果表明,在语音处理中,人类能够对输入的不同声学特征进行抽象,并使用抽象的词典单位来对即将到来的词作推论. 在这种情况下,语音理解的模型应该区分特定声学实现的概率和它实现的抽象词典单位的概率.
这与语音感知文献是一致的:在参与者听故事时收集的ERP数据表明,听众在某种语境下预计到下一个语境(Van Berkum等人,2005年),当语境下这个词在语境下是精密的或语法上可以预测的时,在吵闹条件下的词识别就比较容易(Miller和Isard,1963年)。 此外,从瞳孔测量学研究中可以看出,在更多的语境中,修复听错的词需要更少的认知努力(Smith and Winn, 2025). 我们的研究结果也与关于阅读理解的工作平行,例如,Vigly等人(2025年)的结论认为,表面表层的外观不再能预测有印刷错误的文本的阅读时间。

blocks.en: Our findings for phones and frames are consistent with surprisal theory research that has previously postulated that sub-lexical units are also processed in a predictive manner ( Smith and Levy, 2013 ) . In certain contexts, it has been shown that finer-grained units may play a role in probabilistic anticipation during speech processing. For example, eye-tracking data indicates that variation in voice onset time, a primary correlate to the stop voicing contrast (e.g., /p/ vs. /b/) may be used to predict an upcoming word in ambiguous contexts ( McMurray et al., 2009 ) . Given that predictions from cues like voice onset time are based on even finer-grained input than the phone level, such anticipatory processing may explain the significance of our frame-level surprisal models, despite these units not being linguistically motivated.
blocks.zh: 我们有关手机和帧的研究结果与先前假设的超理论研究一致,即亚语系单位也以预测方式处理(Smith and Levy, 2013 ). 在某些情况下,已经表明,精细的单位在语音处理过程中可能会在概率预测方面发挥作用. 例如,眼跟踪数据表明,语音发音时间的变化,与停止语音对比的主要关联(例如,/p/ vs. /b/)可能被用于在模棱两可的情况下预测即将出现的词语(McMurray等人,2009年)。 鉴于语音发声时间等提示的预测是基于比电话级别更精细的输入,这种预告性处理可能会解释我们帧级的超导模型的意义,尽管这些单元没有语言动机.

blocks.en:
Our findings show that surprisal from speech LMs varies in how well it predicts pupil dilation depending on granularity: for example, whereas unmarginalized phone surprisals from GSLM result in significant improvements over the baseline model, GSLM’s unmarginalized frame and word surprisals do not. While there is a large body of work studying how characteristics such as size and training data impact the so-called psychometric predictive power (PPP) of text LMs ( Kuribayashi et al., 2024 ; Oh et al., 2025 , inter alia ) , this line of work has yet to be explored for speech LMs.
Modeling decisions that yield high PPP for some units may not necessarily do the same for other units, so future work should study how different speech LM characteristics impact their cognitive plausibility across unit inventories.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究结果显示,语音LMs的外延在预测瞳孔扩张的程度方面有所不同,这取决于颗粒性:例如,GSLM的无边际电话外延导致比基线模型的重大改进,GSLM的无边际框架和单词外延没有。 虽然有大量工作在研究大小和培训数据等特征如何影响文本LM的所谓心理计量预测力(PPP)(Kuribayashi等人,2024年); Oh et al., 2025, 除其他外),这一条工作尚待探讨,以便发表LMs讲话。
对一些单位产生高购买力平价的建模决定不一定对其他单位也一样,因此今后的工作应当研究不同语音LM特征如何影响其跨单位库存的认知可信度.

blocks.en: Our finding that surprisal—regardless of modality, abstraction, or unit over which it is obtained—does not add predictive value over a baseline that includes information about when a pupil measurement was taken is consistent with a growing body of literature about the relative importance of surprisal as a predictor in sentence processing. Indeed, it has been shown that factors such as unigram frequency, word length, oculomotor noise, and parafoveal preview can all explain more variance in reading times than surprisal alone ( Heilbron et al., 2023 ; Opedal et al., 2024 ) . Thus, while we provide an approach to estimating word probabilities from speech LMs, our empirical results add to the body of work suggesting a relatively less important role for surprisal in sentence processing.
blocks.zh: 我们的结论认为,无论从模式、抽象方式或获得的单位来看,超额不比基线增加预测值,而基线包括何时进行瞳孔测量的信息,这与越来越多的关于超额在判决处理中的相对重要性的文献是一致的。 事实上,已经证明,单格频率、文字长度、oculomotor噪声和抛物线预览等因素都能够解释阅读时间上的差异,而不只是超音速(Heilbron等人,2023年;Opedal等人,2024年)。 因此,虽然我们提供了一种从语音LMs中估计字数概率的方法,但我们的经验结果增加了整个工作,表明在句子处理中,优势的作用相对较低。

blocks.en: Our results also have implications for natural language processing. Notably, they call into question the construct validity of common speech language modeling benchmarks such as sBLIMP and sWUGGY ( Nguyen et al., 2020 ) . In these benchmarks, recordings of words and non-words (sWUGGY) or syntactically correct and incorrect (sBLIMP) sentences are given to speech language models, and higher scores are given when models deem the words and grammatical audio more probable than the non-words and ungrammatical audio. That is, these benchmarks score models based on the probability they assign to individual realizations of words or sentences. As we have argued here, the probabilities assigned by speech LMs to specific utterances are not representative of the probabilities the model assigns to abstract linguistic units, as the probabilities can reflect the specific utterance’s prosodic, acoustic, or speaker characteristics. This is particularly concerning for cases where the benchmark has been applied to evaluate speech LMs that presume to model abstract, invariant units ( Poli et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2025 , inter alia ) . We hope our work encourages further benchmark development for speech language modeling that accounts for the idea that the relative probability assigned to a specific utterance might change if we manipulate the prosody, voice, or other properties of the audio.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果也对自然语言处理产生影响. 值得注意的是,他们质疑通用语言模型基准的构建有效性,如SBLIMP和SWUGGY(Nguyen等人,2020年)。 在这些基准中,词和非词的录音(sWUGGY)或合成正确和不正确的(sBLIMP)句子被赋予语音语言模型,当模型认为词和语法音频比非词和非语法音频更可能时,给出的分数更高. 也就是说,这些基准根据它们分配给个别实现文字或句子的概率来评分模型. 正如我们在此指出的,语言语言语言分配到具体语言的概率并不代表模型分配给抽象语言单元的概率,因为概率可以反映具体语言的流派、声学或演说者特征。 这尤其涉及采用基准来评估假设模拟抽象、变化无常的单位的言论LMs的情况(Poli等人,2025年;Chang等人,2025年等等)。 我们希望我们的工作能鼓励进一步制定语音建模的基准,因为考虑到这样一种想法,即如果我们操纵音频的音质、语音或其他属性,分配给特定语音的相对概率可能会改变。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
The current body of literature on surprisal theory applies mainly to questions of sentence processing during reading rather than spoken language comprehension. Though speech language models provide a means of applying a similar research program to spoken language comprehension, obtaining surprisal from the speech signal brings several added challenges: namely, the specific psychometric signal to model, the question of which units to consider given the naturally continuous nature of speech, and the complication of modeling many variations of the same abstract unit. We address the last of these with an importance sampling estimator that approximates the surprisal a speech LM assigns to abstract units.
Among the approaches to obtaining surprisal from a speech LM that were tested, we found that our estimations of abstract, lexical surprisals better modeled our signal of processing effort, pupil size, than realization-specific word probabilities. We also found that phone and frame surprisal from speech LMs improved models of pupil size.
These findings suggest that the surprisal of abstract lexical units is a key component of processing difficulty in spoken language comprehension. Our approach to estimating surprisal for abstract units opens the door to further study the contexts in which we base our predictions of upcoming input on sub-lexical units and specific realizations.
blocks.zh:
目前关于附加理论的文献主要适用于阅读过程中的句子处理问题,而不是口语理解. 虽然语音语言模型为应用类似的研究程序来理解口头语言提供了一种手段,但从语音信号中获取优势带来了一些额外的挑战:即:给模型的具体心理测量信号,鉴于语音的自然持续性而考虑哪些单位的问题,以及模拟同一抽象单元的许多变体的复杂性. 我们用一个重要的抽样估计器来处理其中的最后一个问题,该估计值与一个LM分配给抽象单元的语音辅助值相近。
在从一个语言LM中获取附加物的方法中,我们发现,我们对抽象的,词汇性的附加物的估计,比起实现特定的单词概率,更好地模拟了我们的处理努力的信号,瞳孔大小. 我们还发现,语音LMs的电话和帧辅助改进了学生规模模型。
这些调查结果表明,抽象语系单元的优势是口头语言理解中处理困难的一个关键组成部分。 我们估计抽象单位的追加额的方法为进一步研究我们对即将到来的投入的预测所依据的背景和具体实现打开了大门。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our experiments focus on a single listening study ( Winn, 2016 ) with 162 items from the Revised Speech in Noise corpus ( Bilger et al., 1984 ) . We only analyze data from normal hearing listeners, but further examination would be needed to draw conclusions about whether the results hold for people with hearing loss, who have been shown to use context differently than normal hearing listeners ( Winn, 2016 ) . The nature of the stimuli limits the extent to which we can study sub-lexical phenomena and the impact of prosody and indexical information in the speech signal on processing effort during listening. In stimuli designed to study listening in unfamiliar stress patterns (e.g., accented stress patterns), the relative predictive power of marginalized and unmarginalized surprisals from a speech LM may differ.
Likewise, we could imagine the following stimuli in a listening study: “I reached into my toolbox and grabbed a hamburger.” The word hamburger is surprising in this context, but because the phonetic sequence /hæm-/ is expected (e.g., as the start of the word “hammer”), phone surprisal might also be predictive of pupil size. That being the case, without stimuli designed to capture sub-lexical effects, we likely do not fully characterize the role of finer-grained units’ surprisal during speech processing. We are also limited to read (rather than spontaneous) speech in English in this study.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验侧重于一项单一的听力研究(Winn,2016年),其中162项来自《噪声学订正演说》(Bilger等人,1984年)。 我们只分析来自普通听力听众的数据,但还需要进一步检查,以得出结论,这些结果是否适用于听力丧失的人,他们已被证明与普通听力听众不同使用上下文(Winn,2016年). 刺激的性质限制了我们可以研究亚语态现象的程度,以及语音信号中流音和索引信息对听觉过程中处理努力的影响. 在旨在研究不熟悉的压力模式(例如,突出的压力模式)中的听力刺激中,语言LM中边缘化和未边缘化的上层人的相对预测力可能有所不同.
类似地,我们可以想象在一项倾听研究中的以下刺激:“我伸进工具箱,抓住了汉堡。” 汉堡这个词在这种背景下是令人惊讶的,但因为声调序列 /hæm-/(例如,作为“hammer”一词的开头)是预期的,所以电话附加也可能预测学生的大小。 因此,如果没有旨在捕捉亚语言效应的刺激措施,我们可能无法充分描述精细单位在语音处理过程中的优势作用。 我们还仅限于在本研究报告中阅读(而不是自发的)英语演讲。

blocks.en: Another limitation of the present study is the ASR sample rejection; though this step is necessary to exclude TTS errors, it is also a point at which errors can be made. Though a fuller error analysis is not possible because we do not have ground truth transcriptions for the sampled audio, we suspect that the most likely errors would be mis-transcriptions of valid realizations of a word. This may result in a bias against audio with especially atypical prosody or speaker features. We expect that exploring larger ASR models would decrease such errors, albeit at higher computational costs. We expect that better ASR models and a higher initial sample size N N would also contribute to higher estimator coverage overall.
blocks.zh: 本研究的另一个局限性是ASR样本拒绝;虽然这一步骤对于排除TTS错误是必要的,但它也是可以作出错误的时刻. 虽然由于我们没有样本音频的地面真伪记录,无法进行更充分的误差分析,但我们怀疑,最可能的错误是错误地描述一个词的有效实现。 这可能导致对具有特别非典型的音质或扬声器特性的音频的偏见。 我们预计,探索较大的ASR模型将减少这种错误,尽管计算成本较高。 我们期望更好的ASR模型和更高的NN初步样本规模也会有助于总体更高的估计覆盖率。

blocks.en: We also note that the present work only studies abstract units at the level of orthographic words and does not estimate marginalized phone surprisals. A direct application of our importance sampling approach to the phone granularity would yield estimates of the probabilities speech LMs assign to maximally context-sensitive phones in our stimuli across many speakers. However, extending our approach to study less context-sensitive units at the phone level (e.g., allophones or phonemes) would require extending the method to also sample the relevant units in diverse phonological contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们还注意到,目前的工作只研究正体字一级的抽象单位,并不估计被边缘化的电话附属单位. 对电话颗粒性直接采用我们的重要抽样方法,将产生对许多发言者在刺激中尽可能考虑到具体情况的手机的概率语音LMs的估计。 然而,扩大我们在电话级别上对上下文不太敏感的单元(如Allophone或电话)的研究范围,就需要扩大这一方法,以在各种音响背景中也对有关单元进行抽样。

blocks.en: Ethical Concerns
blocks.zh: 伦理问题

blocks.en: We use only previously studied pupillometry and speech data with explicit permission from the author ( Winn, 2016 ) . We do not foresee any ethical concerns from the use of this data to study human speech processing.
blocks.zh: 我们只使用之前研究过的学生测量和语音数据,但得到作者的明确许可(Winn,2016年)。 我们没有预见到使用这些数据来研究人类语音处理的伦理问题。

blocks.en: Appendix C Speech LM Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 发言 LM 细节

blocks.en: Here we give further details on the speech LMs we use as target distributions p Δ {{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}p}}_{{\color[rgb]{0.2656,0.4648,0.668}\Delta}}}} to obtain surprisal values from the speech signal. The generative speech language model (GSLM) released by Lakhotia et al. (2021) is a transformer decoder trained with a context length of 3,072 speech tokens. The speech tokens are drawn from a 200-unit codebook obtained by applying k k -means clustering to features from layer 6 of the HuBERT feature extractor ( Hsu et al., 2021 ) . Due to the temporal resolution of HuBERT, each speech token corresponds to 20 ms of audio sampled at 16 kHz. The context length of 3,072 tokens, therefore, corresponds to 61.44 s of audio. We refer to these tokens as representations for frames of speech.
blocks.zh: 在此我们详细介绍我们用作目标分布的语音 LMs p \\\ xcolor[rgb]{0, 0\}\\\ xcolor[rgb]{0, 0}p\ xcolor[rgb]{0.2656,0.4648,0.668\ Delta} 从语音信号中获取附加值。 Lakhotia等人(2021年)发布的基因化语音语言模型(GSLM)是经过上下文长度3,072个语音符号培训的变压器解码器. 语音符号取自一个200单元的编码本,该编码本通过对HuBERT特性提取器(Hsu等人,2021年)第6层的特征应用kk-意为集群而获得。 由于HuBERT的时间分辨率,每个语音符号对应在16千赫时取样的20ms音频. 因此,3,072个令牌的上下文长度相当于61.44s的音频. 我们把这些标志称为发言框架的说明。

blocks.en: SpiRit-LM is a continuously pretrained, multimodal variant of Llama-2 ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ; Touvron et al., 2023 ) . The 7B-parameter model was further pretrained on strings of interleaved text and speech tokens, meaning it can take speech as input and generate it. Its speech tokens are also obtained from discretized features of a HuBERT variant, with each speech token corresponding to 40 ms of speech sampled at 16 kHz.
blocks.zh: SpiRit-LM是Llama-2(Nguyen等人,2025年;Touvron等人,2023年)的一个连续预训的多式变体. 7B参数模型被进一步预先训练在互页文本和语音符号的字符串上,意思是它可以把语音当作输入并生成. 其语音符号也从HuBERT变体的光碟化特性获得,每个语音符号对应在16千赫时抽取的40ms的语音符号.

blocks.en: Llama-Mimi trains Llama-3 ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) for speech language modeling using representations from Mimi ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) , the same neural codec used by our proposal distribution. While Llama-Mimi extends Llama’s vocabulary, it does not interleave text and speech during further pretraining. We use both the 1.3B and 8B variants of Llama-Mimi, which are both trained on 240k hours of speech data. All models are trained and evaluated on English speech.
blocks.zh: Llama-Mimi列车Llama-3(Grattafiori等人,2024年)使用Mimi(Défossez等人,2024年)的表示方式进行语音模型化,这与我们的提案分发所使用的神经编码相同. Llama-Mimi扩展了Llama的词汇, 我们同时使用Llama-Mimi的1.3B和8B两个变体,它们都接受了240k小时语音数据的培训. 所有模特都接受英语演讲方面的培训和评价。
